Situation: As of 2026-10-21, Corvale East holds 115 capsules of gabapentin 100 mg at 16.1 per day, giving 7.1 days on hand. Corvale Lakeside holds 82 capsules at 4.6 per day, giving 18 days on hand. Corvale General holds 244 capsules at 12.9 days on hand. All stock at East and Lakeside is labeled by STALLION LABORATORIES PRIVATE LIMITED (NDC 72737000503).

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show gabapentin is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Supply at Corvale East is below the internal target. Corvale Lakeside can spare stock without falling below two weeks. No national shortage is declared.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 18 capsules of gabapentin 100 mg from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East. Approval: pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. If transfer cannot meet need, purchase from Westminster Pharmaceuticals, LLC. Approval: buyer.
3. If needed, purchase from ADVANCED RX OF TENNESSEE, LLC. Approval: buyer.
4. If needed, purchase from Actavis Pharma, Inc. Approval: buyer.
5. If needed, purchase from Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC. Approval: buyer.

Not recommended: No clinical changes or formulary adjustments at this time.
